# mapx Docs

> Maps, search, navigation, elevation, transit, traffic and static images for Austria, from official open data. Free API token.

mapx provides maps and location APIs for Austria, built only on official open data (BEV, GIP.at, ASFINAG, GeoSphere Austria, ÖBB and others). Every page is also available as Markdown: the same address with `.md` at the end instead of the trailing slash (for example https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-map.md). All text in one file: https://docs.mapx.at/llms-full.txt. German version: https://docs.mapx.at/de/llms.txt.

## Facts for using the API

- **Base URLs:** API `https://api.mapx.at/v1/`, routing `https://routing.mapx.at/`, search `https://search.mapx.at/`, tiles `https://tiles.mapx.at/`. Data covers Austria only.
- **Authentication:** free account at https://account.mapx.at, create a token under "Tokens" (no usage-based charge). Servers and scripts send `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`; browsers, images and MapLibre tile URLs use the query parameter `access_token=YOUR_TOKEN`.
- **Token kinds:** public `mx_pk_…` for websites and apps (`GET`/`HEAD` only, read-only products, bound to allowed origins or an Android app); secret `mx_sk_…` for servers, scripts and CI (never in a web page or app, optionally bound to IP ranges).
- **Coordinates:** always `lon,lat` (WGS84), several points separated by `;`, so longitude comes first.
- **OpenAPI:** https://api.mapx.at/v1/openapi.json (works without a token). CORS is open.
- **Limits:** per token and zone (`tiles`, `search`, `route`, `elevation`, `static`, `heavy`); exceeding one returns `429` with `Retry-After`; numbers in [Access and limits](https://docs.mapx.at/start/access-and-limits.md). Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
- **Attribution is required:** CC BY 4.0, name the source and license wherever the map or result is visible; JSON responses carry an `attribution` field. Text per tileset: [Attribution and license](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution.md).

## Get started

- [Get started with mapx](https://docs.mapx.at/start/index.md): Start with the mapx maps and location APIs for Austria: get a free API token, then copy working code for a map, a search and a route.
- [What is mapx? Maps API for Austria](https://docs.mapx.at/start/what-is-mapx.md): mapx is a set of maps and location APIs for Austria built only on official open data: tiles, geocoding, routing, elevation, transit and more.
- [API token, access and rate limits](https://docs.mapx.at/start/access-and-limits.md): Get a free mapx API token, learn the difference between public and secret tokens, how to send them, rate limits per zone, CORS and caching.
- [First map with MapLibre in 5 minutes](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-map.md): Build your first mapx web map: a complete HTML file with MapLibre GL JS or the mapx-gl SDK and a public token. Copy, save and open it in a browser.
- [First search: geocoding request](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-search.md): Find an address or place in Austria with one geocoding request (curl, JavaScript, Python), then show the result as a marker on a map.
- [First route: routing request](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-route.md): Request a driving route from Vienna to Melk with the mapx routing API (curl, JavaScript, Python) and draw the result as a line on a map.
- [Glossary of mapx and GIS terms](https://docs.mapx.at/start/glossary.md): Glossary of terms used in the mapx documentation: annotations, cadastral municipality (KG), contours, isochrones, PMTiles, Terrain-RGB and more.
- [FAQ: token, licence, offline use](https://docs.mapx.at/start/faq.md): Answers on mapx: do I need a token, what does it cost, commercial use under CC BY 4.0, data freshness, offline maps, data outside Austria, errors 401 and 403.

## Guides

- [Guides for maps, search and routing](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/index.md): Task-oriented guides for every mapx product: maps, search, navigation, traffic, transit, static images, elevation and parcels, plus techniques.
- [Maps guide: vector tiles and styles](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/maps.md): Show a mapx vector map in MapLibre GL JS, switch styles, add tilesets and overlays, including weather and traffic layers.
- [Address search: geocoding and autofill](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/search.md): Add address and place search for Austria to your app: geocoding, type-ahead Search Box, address autofill for forms and address validation.
- [Routing guide: car, truck, bike, foot](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/navigation.md): Plan routes for car, truck, bike and foot in Austria: tolls, isochrones, travel-time matrices, map matching and tour planning.
- [Traffic guide: incidents and layer](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/traffic.md): Show traffic incidents, motorway speed limits and a traffic layer on the map and use traffic-aware routes, with the mapx traffic API.
- [Transit guide: public transport departures](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/transit.md): Query public transport journeys, stops and departure boards in Austria from the scheduled timetable with the mapx transit API.
- [Static images guide: map as image](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/static-images.md): Render map images as PNG or WebP with pins, paths and GeoJSON for reports, e-mails and web pages, using the mapx static images API.
- [Elevation guide: height profile and terrain](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/elevation.md): Get heights at points and elevation profiles, use terrain models and show 3D terrain in the map: elevation API and terrain tilesets for Austria.
- [Parcels guide: cadastre lookup](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/parcels.md): Find the cadastral parcel at a point, draw parcel boundaries on the map and read the parcel attributes with the mapx cadastre for Austria.
- [Custom map style from the basemap](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/style-the-basemap.md): Write your own MapLibre style for the mapx vector basemap of Austria: style land use, water, roads, buildings and boundaries layer by layer.
- [Contour lines over orthophoto](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/overlay-contours.md): Place contour lines (Höhenlinien) with index lines and elevation labels over the orthophoto or the basemap in MapLibre GL JS.
- [3D terrain map with orthophoto](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/3d-terrain.md): A 3D map with real elevation relief, hillshading and aerial imagery on top, using MapLibre GL JS and a free token.
- [Elevation profile chart in JavaScript](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/elevation-profile.md): Query an elevation profile for a route through the elevation API and draw it as an SVG chart, in plain JavaScript.
- [mapx data in QGIS: XYZ and vector tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/qgis.md): Add DTM, DSM, orthophoto and vector tiles to QGIS: XYZ connection, vector tile connection and PMTiles directly.
- [Self-host PMTiles files](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/self-host-pmtiles.md): Download or mirror PMTiles files and serve them with range requests, CORS and caching from your own server, S3 or CDN.
- [SDK mapx-gl for MapLibre](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/sdk/index.md): A small add-on for MapLibre GL JS: map factory, typed helpers for every API, route planner, layer switcher, parcel and departures popups.
- [SDK helpers: one function per API](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/sdk/helpers.md): One typed function per API: search, geocoding, routing, matrix, optimization, parcels, elevation, traffic, transit, weather and static images.
- [SDK controls and popups for MapLibre](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/sdk/controls.md): RouteControl, LayerControl, SearchControl, ParcelPopup and DeparturesPopup: ready-made map tools of the mapx-gl SDK in one line each.
- [SDK errors and retries (MapxError)](https://docs.mapx.at/guides/sdk/errors.md): MapxError carries code, status, param and allowed values from the problem+json response of the mapx APIs; retry only what is worth retrying.

## API reference

- [API reference: all endpoints](https://docs.mapx.at/api/index.md): Reference of all mapx APIs for Austria with endpoints, parameters, examples and a live playground, generated from the OpenAPI description.
- [Tiles API: TileJSON and XYZ tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/api/tiles.md): Tiles API for Austria: tileset list, TileJSON and XYZ tiles as vector, raster and elevation (Terrain-RGB), with parameters and examples.
- [Map styles API: MapLibre styles](https://docs.mapx.at/api/styles.md): Styles API: ready-made MapLibre styles, glyphs (fonts), sprites and rendered raster tiles (Static Tiles) for Austria, with parameters and examples.
- [Geocoding API for Austria](https://docs.mapx.at/api/geocoding.md): Geocoding API for Austria: forward, reverse and batch geocoding of addresses, streets, places, postcodes and parcels, with parameters and examples.
- [Search Box API: type-ahead search](https://docs.mapx.at/api/search-box.md): Search Box API for autocomplete: suggestions while the user types, details of a result and places by category, with parameters and examples.
- [Address autofill and validation API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/address.md): Address autofill for forms and address validation against the official Austrian address register: endpoints, parameters and examples.
- [Routing API: directions, isochrones, matrix](https://docs.mapx.at/api/directions.md): Routing API for Austria: routes for car, truck, bike and foot, isochrones, travel-time matrices and map matching, with parameters and examples.
- [Route optimization API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/optimization.md): Route optimization API: best order for up to 25 stops and tour planning for several vehicles, with parameters and example requests.
- [Transit API: public transport Austria](https://docs.mapx.at/api/transit.md): Transit API for public transport in Austria: journeys, stops and departure boards from the timetable data, with parameters and examples.
- [Static images API: map as PNG or WebP](https://docs.mapx.at/api/static-images.md): Static images API: render map images as PNG or WebP with pins, paths and GeoJSON overlays for reports, e-mails and listings, with examples.
- [Tilequery and Parcel API](https://docs.mapx.at/api/tilequery.md): Tilequery API: features around a point from any vector tileset, plus the cadastral parcel at a point (parcel API), with parameters and examples.
- [Elevation API: height and profile](https://docs.mapx.at/api/elevation.md): Elevation API for Austria: terrain height and surface height for points and elevation profiles along a line, with parameters and example requests.
- [Weather API: forecast and nowcast](https://docs.mapx.at/api/weather.md): Weather API for Austria: current observations, hourly forecast, precipitation nowcast, warnings and weather tiles from GeoSphere Austria.
- [Air quality API for Austria](https://docs.mapx.at/api/air-quality.md): Air quality index, pollutants and Saharan dust for a point in Austria from GeoSphere Austria: endpoints, parameters and example requests.
- [Climate API: solar, snow, heat days](https://docs.mapx.at/api/climate.md): Climate API for a point in Austria: solar potential, climate normals, heat days, snow and drought from GeoSphere Austria, with parameters and examples.
- [Traffic API: incidents and speed limits](https://docs.mapx.at/api/traffic.md): Traffic API for Austria: traffic incidents, motorway speed limits, signs and traffic tiles, with parameters and example requests.
- [Errors, status codes and rate limits](https://docs.mapx.at/api/errors.md): Error codes (problem+json), HTTP status codes, rate limits per zone and caching rules of all mapx APIs, with Retry-After on 429.
- [Migration to English API names](https://docs.mapx.at/api/migration.md): Former German API IDs and field names, their English successors, the deprecation headers and the sunset date 2027-05-31.

## Tilesets

- [Tilesets: vector and raster tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/index.md): All mapx tilesets for Austria with type, zoom range and source date: basemap, cadastre, contours, orthophoto, terrain and surface models.
- [Basemap vector tileset (streets)](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/streets.md): Vector base map of Austria from open government data: land use, buildings, roads, rail, water, boundaries, names, house numbers. z0 to z16.
- [Cadastre tileset: parcel boundaries](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/cadastre.md): Parcel boundaries from the BEV Digital Cadastral Map as vector tiles, z16, with cadastral municipality and parcel number.
- [Contour lines tileset (Höhenlinien)](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/contours.md): Contour lines for Austria as vector tiles, z10 to z16, 100 m to 10 m interval, derived from the BEV ALS-DTM 1 m.
- [DTM terrain model tileset (Terrain-RGB)](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/terrain-rgb.md): Digital terrain model of Austria as Terrain-RGB tiles (Mapbox encoding, 0.1 m), z5 to z16, from the BEV ALS-DTM 1 m.
- [DSM surface model tileset](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/dsm.md): Digital surface model of Austria including buildings and vegetation as Terrain-RGB (0.1 m), z5 to z16, from the BEV ALS-DOM 1 m.
- [Orthophoto tileset: aerial imagery](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/orthophoto.md): Aerial imagery of Austria from the BEV as WebP tiles, z5 to z18, 20 cm, with an unambiguous flight-block choice per pixel.
- [Sentinel-2 satellite imagery tileset](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/sentinel2.md): Always up-to-date, cloud-free satellite image of Austria from Copernicus Sentinel-2 as WebP tiles, z5 to z13, 10 m, updated daily at 02:00.
- [Orthophoto flight blocks tileset](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/orthophoto-flight-blocks.md): Which flight supplies which orthophoto pixel: winning areas of the BEV surveys with flight period, as vector tiles z6 to z17.
- [Rest areas tileset (ASFINAG)](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/rest-areas.md): Rest areas and truck parking of ASFINAG as vector tiles (tileset rastanlagen) and as the search category rastplatz in the mapx search.
- [Sharing stations tileset (ÖBB)](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/sharing.md): Sharing stations (cargo bikes, bikes) of ÖBB as vector tiles (tileset sharing) and as the search category sharing in the mapx search API.

## Reference

- [Reference: tiles, styles, attribution](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/index.md): Reference pages for the mapx APIs: attribution and license, changelog, coordinates, tile scheme, Terrain-RGB encoding, style specification and the SDK type reference.
- [Basemap layers and style specification](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/style-spec.md): All layers of the mapx streets vector tileset with fields and values, plus the ready-made style IDs. Reference for custom MapLibre styles.
- [Terrain-RGB elevation encoding](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/terrain-rgb.md): How mapx encodes elevation as color in Terrain-RGB tiles (Mapbox encoding, 0.1 m): value range, rounding and decoding functions.
- [Tile scheme: Web Mercator, z/x/y](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/tile-scheme.md): Tile scheme of the mapx tiles: Web Mercator, z/x/y addressing, 512-pixel tiles, resolution per zoom level and overzoom.
- [Coordinates: lon,lat, WGS84, Web Mercator](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/coordinates.md): Coordinate order lon,lat in all mapx APIs, WGS84 versus Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) and official Austrian sources in MGI and ETRS89.
- [Attribution and license (CC BY 4.0)](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/attribution.md): Which source to credit under CC BY 4.0 when you show mapx maps or data: ready-made attribution text per tileset and API, for MapLibre, print and images.
- [Changelog: API and tileset changes](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/changelog.md): Changes to the mapx APIs, tilesets and these docs, grouped as Added, Changed, Deprecated and Removed, with release dates and sunset notices.
- [SDK reference](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/sdk/index.md): Type reference of mapx-gl: functions, controls, options and response types.

## Optional

- [Examples: runnable map code](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/index.md): Twenty-six runnable examples with MapLibre GL JS and the mapx-gl SDK: maps, search, navigation, elevation, transit, traffic, static images, parcels, weather.
- [Embed a map in an HTML page](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/embed-map.md): Embed a mapx map with the ready-made style in any HTML page with MapLibre GL JS: a minimal runnable example with a public token.
- [Switch basemap example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/switch-basemap.md): Switch between the map, aerial imagery (orthophoto) and terrain with MapLibre GL JS and mapx styles: a runnable basemap switcher example.
- [Time of day and night mode example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/time-of-day.md): Show the default mapx style in four lighting moods, including a night mode, with MapLibre GL JS: runnable example code to copy.
- [3D terrain example with orthophoto](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/terrain-3d.md): Aerial imagery draped over the terrain model, tilted and exaggerated: 3D terrain in MapLibre GL JS with mapx Terrain-RGB tiles, runnable code.
- [Elevation on click example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/elevation-on-click.md): A map click queries the elevation at a point, either terrain height or surface height including buildings, with the mapx elevation API.
- [Elevation profile example on a map](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/elevation-profile.md): Click a line on the map and see its elevation profile (Höhenprofil): elevation profile API with runnable MapLibre GL JS code to copy.
- [Place search example (geocoding)](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/search.md): Search for places, addresses and peaks in Austria and fly to the hit on the map: geocoding API example with MapLibre GL JS and runnable code.
- [Route example: start and destination](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/route.md): Click a start and a destination on the map and get the route with length and duration from the mapx routing API; runnable code to copy.
- [Weather overlay example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/weather-overlay.md): Temperature, precipitation or wind as an overlay on the map, hour chosen with a slider: weather tiles of GeoSphere Austria, runnable code.
- [Precipitation radar animation example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/radar-animation.md): Rain and snow of the next three hours in 15-minute steps, played as an animation on the map: weather nowcast of GeoSphere Austria, runnable code.
- [Isochrone example: reachability map](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/isochrone.md): Which area can be reached in 5, 10 and 15 minutes? Draw isochrones (reachability) with the mapx routing API; runnable code to copy.
- [Travel-time matrix example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/matrix.md): Get travel times between several places in one request with the mapx matrix API (Fahrzeitmatrix): a runnable example you can copy.
- [Cadastre example: parcel on click](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/parcel-on-click.md): Show parcel boundaries (Kataster) over aerial imagery; a click names the parcel number. Cadastre tileset and parcel API, runnable code.
- [TileJSON source example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/tilejson-source.md): Add the mapx orthophoto and contour lines as TileJSON sources without a ready-made style in MapLibre GL JS: runnable example code.
- [3D buildings example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/buildings-3d.md): Extruded 3D buildings with BEV heights on the mapx vector basemap, camera tilted, in MapLibre GL JS. Runnable code you can copy.
- [Search Box example with suggestions](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/search-box.md): Suggestions while typing, position after the click and a type filter: type-ahead search with the mapx Search Box API, runnable code.
- [Address autofill example for forms](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/autofill.md): Type a street, pick a suggestion and the form fields fill themselves: address autofill for Austrian addresses with the mapx autofill API. Runnable code.
- [Address validation example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/address-validation.md): Check an address against the official Austrian address register with the address validation API and show the corrected result. Runnable code.
- [Reverse geocoding example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/reverse-geocode.md): Click the map and get the nearest address: reverse geocoding with the mapx geocoding API for Austria, runnable code with MapLibre GL JS.
- [Truck route example with options](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/truck-route.md): Truck routing with vehicle size, avoiding tolls and motorways, and alternatives: a runnable example for the mapx routing API.
- [Tour planning example: best stop order](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/optimization.md): Click stops on the map and get the best order from the depot and back with the mapx route optimization API: runnable tour planning example.
- [Public transit route example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/transit-route.md): Click start and destination and get the walking and riding legs of a public transport journey in Austria with the mapx transit API.
- [Departures at a stop example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/departures.md): Click near a public transport stop in Austria and see the next departures: transit departures API with a live map and runnable code.
- [Traffic flow and incidents example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/traffic.md): Traffic style plus the active incidents of the visible map area: show traffic flow and road incidents in Austria with the mapx traffic API.
- [Static image example for a listing](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/static-image.md): Click a place and get a ready-made static map image URL with a pin, for example for a real estate listing: static images API, runnable code.
- [GeoJSON overlay on the map example](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/geojson-overlay.md): Show your own GeoJSON points, line and polygon over the mapx style, with a popup on click, in MapLibre GL JS. Runnable code to copy.
- [SDK example: route planner and layers](https://docs.mapx.at/examples/sdk-controls.md): RouteControl with truck profile, LayerControl, search and style switcher: ready-made map controls of the mapx-gl SDK in one runnable example.



- [Use cases: logistics, tourism, real estate](https://docs.mapx.at/use-cases/index.md): Use cases for the mapx maps and location APIs in Austria: logistics, municipalities, real estate and tourism, each with the matching APIs and code.
- [Real estate: parcel, solar, listing maps](https://docs.mapx.at/use-cases/real-estate.md): Parcel dossier, solar, heat and snow at the site, a static image for the listing and reachability of an address, with code that runs as it is.
- [Logistics: truck routing and matrix](https://docs.mapx.at/use-cases/logistics.md): Truck routing with vehicle size, travel-time matrices, tour planning and traffic for deliveries and fleets, built on the mapx APIs for Austria.
- [Tourism: bike routes and elevation profile](https://docs.mapx.at/use-cases/tourism.md): Bike and mountain-bike routes, cycle-route layer, elevation profile and weather for tours and visitor information, built on the mapx APIs.
- [Maps for municipalities and administration](https://docs.mapx.at/use-cases/municipalities.md): Parcels, address validation, transit departures and an embedded map for municipal websites and administration tools.
